rules.statement: Classify jurisdiction and governmental body from source evidence, never calendar labels.
No automatic direct mayor for ordinary councils; explicit concejo abierto is separately labelled within the one municipal representation mandate.
Ceuta, Melilla and Formentera combined bodies appear once. Navarra Parliament is not duplicated as a provincial council.
Every office, including four source-identified historical codes, has exactly one draft classification.
Human review categories do not clear automatically on pack acceptance; resolve named institutional-mode and special-tier holds explicitly.
